policy_title: Restore Neighbourhood Policing and Tackle Antisocial Behaviour
stated: Labour will introduce a new Neighbourhood Policing Guarantee, recruiting thousands of new police officers, police and community support officers, and special constables, funded by a Police Efficiency and Collaboration programme, to restore patrols and provide communities with a named officer. They will tackle antisocial behaviour with new 'Respect Orders' to ban persistent adult offenders from town centres and force fly-tippers and vandals to clean up their mess. Shoplifting immunity will be scrapped, and a new specific offence for assaults on shopworkers will be created.

source.quote: Labour will introduce a new Neighbourhood Policing Guarantee, restoring patrols to our town centres by recruiting thousands of new police officers, police and community support officers, and special constables. Communities and residents will have a named officer to turn to when things go wrong. These new recruits will be paid for by tackling waste through a new Police Efficiency and Collaboration programme for England and Wales. Labour will fix this by introducing new Respect Orders – powers to ban persistent adult offenders from town centres, which will stamp out issues such as public drinking and drug use. Fly-tippers and vandals will also be forced to clean up the mess they have created. Labour will scrap the effective immunity for some shoplifting introduced by the Conservatives and create a new specific offence for assaults on shopworkers that will protect them from threats and violence.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets crime rates, antisocial behaviour, policing capacity, and community safety through new officers, Respect Orders, and new criminal offences — core O5 indicators.

Respect Orders ban named individuals from town centres — a state-imposed restriction on freedom of movement for persistent offenders — and new criminal offences expand coercive powers; both mechanisms directly worsen the personal-liberty indicator for those affected, non-negligibly.

A dedicated criminal offence for assaults on shopworkers directly bears on job safety and conditions for a large occupational group in retail, moving the 'workers' rights and conditions' indicator for a sector with documented high rates of violence and abuse.

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: the policy's designed-for safety/order effect (O5), the concrete liberty cost of Respect Order banning powers and new offences (O10), and the targeted improvement in working conditions for shopworkers (O4). No material bearing on O12 given the stated (if contested) efficiency-funding mechanism, and O15 effects are derivative of the O5 safety channel rather than an independent social-trust mechanism.
